The Abbey Suites offer a three-dimensional complementary wall tile proposal in all four warm tones for the Abbey series. Adding texture and character to spaces through it's narrow or wide linear designs.

Description: The Calacata Gold generates unique atmospheres and vivid spaces offering a balance between its matte and polished finishes. Also adding warmth through the it's gold veining, making way for versatile combinations with different elements.

Inspired by the finest marbles around the world, our Slabs collection allows you to accomplish the look and feel of marble without the price tag. Create stunning, awe-inspiring floors, or get creative and use for accent walls or even countertops, the possibilities are endless.

Calacatta Oro offers a contemporary take on one of the most prized marbles, with its distinctive mink-coloured veining flowing naturally over a snow-white base. The visual composition of its marked, flowing veins runs through the imposing pieces with exceptional precision, preserving the authenticity of the original designs while promoting a sense of harmonious continuity. The result is a continuous surface where the patterns and islands of colour become the absolute protagonists. Each ceramic slab conveys the majesty of natural stone, enhanced by state-of-the- art technology that guarantees resistance and durability.
Add texture and character to your spaces with our Carve series, presenting a soft metallic carved finish on top of a steel color that will remind you of a work of art.

Description: Statuary, the spirit of marble. A contemporary take on natural Italian marble setting new standards in styles and trends whilst conserving all its prestige and quality. A faithful ceramic adaptation of the marble par excellence. The same texture, the same aesthetic effect, but with more design input and enhanced functionality.

Stone Basel replicates the soft touch of volcanic rock polished by water and its texture under light in a porcelain proposal for both floor and wall. This collection is ideal for those who seek perfection and take care of every detail.

The Tegel collection merges traditional and modern contemporary, vibrant graphics. These luxurious tiles transform spaces into visually stunning displays, blending timeless charm with modern design flair.

The natural elegance of an intense black and the satin touch of slate. This collection evokes the eroded effect of natural stone plus the unalterable performance of porcelain. Perfect for interiors that aim to be a refuge where everyone feels at home.
A series that speaks for itself. With its wavy, organic reliefs and its white matte finish, Tissue is the perfect choice to bring continuity and elegance to your next project.
Cut vein travertine re-defined. Our Trevi Collection is a soft and elegant interpretation of this stone. This collection comes in a single format with a neutral color palette.

Accurately reproduces the Italian stone “Ceppo di Gre” with large pebbles and mineral sediments embedded in its surface. The Unique Ground series, along with its neutral and chromatic hues, is elegant and sophisticated.

The Statuario Venato series is inspired by this precious and timeless Italian marble, with veins in shades of gray that run longitudinally through its pieces. Available in polished and matte finishes, HD printing brings this porcelain to life with its realism, elegance and contemporary character.
A Mesmerizing Hybrid of Marble’s Elegance and Stone’s Strength. Experience a unique textural journey, elevating spaces with timeless sophistication.
The Wind series presents longitudinal reliefs at different heights, inspired by the dynamics of the wind. Available in a white matte finish, it brings sophistication to projects of any style.
The Winter collection replicates the neutral tones of concrete in a bright, wavy and irregular surface, creating a handmade look that will warm up any space.
Inspired by ancient Moroccan tiles, the glossy finish and long, rectangular shape, irregular edges, and exquisite color range of the Zellige series are bound to create magical spaces.
